value.modalContent:
Comprehensive Cultivation Blueprint
Rice / Paddy
Cereal Grain • 4.5 - 6.2 Tons/Ha
Print Plan
Recommended Seed Rate
40 - 50 kg/hectare (Transplanting) | 20 kg/ha for SRI method
Water Management & Irrigation Milestones
Maintain 2-5 cm standing water layer during tillering and panicle development. Drain 10 days before harvest.
Cultivation Timeline & Milestones
Land Preparation (Day 0-15)
Deep summer plowing followed by puddling 2 times with cage wheels; incorporate 10 tons well-rotted FYM.
Sowing & Seed Treatment (Day 15-25)
Treat seeds with Carbendazim (2g/kg) or Trichoderma viride (10g/kg). Raise nursery in wet beds.
Transplanting & Weeding (Day 25-45)
Transplant 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20x15 cm spacing. Apply pre-emergence herbicide within 3 days.
Panicle & Grain Fill (Day 45-95)
Ensure soil remains flooded; spray 1% potassium nitrate (13:0:45) at 50% flowering to boost grain weight.
Harvest & Threshing (Day 95-125)
Harvest when 85% grains turn golden straw color and moisture drops to 20-22%. Dry grains to 12% for safe storage.
Balanced Nutrition & Fertilizer Schedule
Basal Application (At Sowing)
50% Nitrogen + 100% Phosphorus + 75% Potassium + 25 kg Zinc Sulfate/ha
Top Dressing 1 (Vegetative Phase)
25% Nitrogen top-dressing at active tillering (21-25 days after transplanting)
Top Dressing 2 (Flowering/Booting)
25% Nitrogen + 25% Potassium at panicle initiation stage (40-45 days)
Critical Pest & Disease Early Warnings
Watch for Brown Planthopper (BPH), Stem Borer, and Bacterial Leaf Blight during humid cloud cover.
